    Safety and Security
    • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.
    • Hands-on cruise control with lane change
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. Experience the power and capability of the 2019 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT. This exceptional full-size pickup is built to handle your toughest tasks with ease, whether you're hauling heavy loads, towing a trailer, or navigating rough terrain. The Sierra 1500 SLT's bold, muscular design is complemented by a chrome grille, deep-tinted glass, and 18-inch machined aluminum wheels, giving it a commanding presence on the road. Inside, the premium leather-appointed seating and driver's memory seat ensure you'll enjoy a tailored, comfortable ride every time.

With its impressive capabilities, advanced technology, and refined styling, the 2019 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT is the perfect choice for those who demand the best from their full-size pickup. Experience the difference for yourself by scheduling a test drive at our dealership today.

description: Experience the perfect blend of rugged capability and high-end luxury with this 2020 GMC Sierra 1500 AT4. Finished in a sharp Onyx Black, this 4WD Crew Cab is powered by the efficient yet muscular 3.0L I6 Turbodiesel engine. Whether you are navigating city streets or exploring backroads, this truck is designed to stand out with its signature red recovery hooks, off-road suspension, and body-color surround grille.Premium Comfort and StyleThe interior of this AT4 is a masterclass in comfort. Parking is simpler than ever thanks to HD Surround Vision and Ultrasonic Front and Rear Park Assist. The Bed View Camera and Hitch Guidance with Hitch View make hooking up a trailer a one-person job. The durable spray-on bedliner with the AT4 logo protects your truck while you utilize the 120-volt bed-mounted power outlet. Its not just a truck, its a versatile tool built to exceed every expectation.Faster. Simpler. More Transparent. Superior Automotive Group has helped thousands of customers find the right car by leveraging one of Arkansas' largest selections of new and pre-owned vehicles at unparalleled prices. Yet, it's our extra-mile customer service and uncommonly candid and respectful staff that have won the trust and loyalty of Arkansas drivers for 30 years. Come visit one of our Superior dealerships today and let us exceed your expectations.

Finished in Bright White Clear‑Coat with a black cloth interior featuring a 40/20/40 front bench seat, this Ram delivers a straightforward, no‑nonsense design built for serious use.
Power comes from the legendary 6.7L Cummins® turbo‑diesel inline‑six engine, paired with a robust 6‑speed automatic 68RFE transmission. Equipped with manual and electronic shift‑on‑the‑fly four‑wheel drive, a 3.73 axle ratio, anti‑spin rear differential, and hill start assist, this Ram provides confident traction and control whether on the job site or hauling heavy loads. The 31‑gallon fuel tank supports long‑distance driving and extended workdays.

ParkView® rear backup camera, tire‑fill alert, and tire‑pressure monitoring add convenience and safety when maneuvering or maintaining the vehicle.

Exterior highlights include chrome front and rear bumpers, chrome grille surround, 18‑inch chrome‑clad steel wheels, LED bed lighting, power‑heated trailer‑tow mirrors with courtesy lamps and running lights, locking tailgate, and durable all‑season tires that complete this truck’s tough, job‑ready appearance.
